preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of intersections N must be between 2 and 10.
The number of roads M must be between 1 and the maximum number of unique roads for N intersections.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Ai <= N and 1 <= Bi <= N and Ai != Bi for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct intersections within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Ci <= 10 for Ai, Bi, Ci in roads)
preconditions.description: The length of each road Ci must be between 1 and 10.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of shortest paths from Tomya's house to Ciel's restaurant.
